name: roadstyle-wasm
description: roadstyle's Rust engine in the browser: a MapLibre style and vector tiles of a road network, made from a roads Parquet file

scripts.build: cargo build --profile dist --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --manifest-path ../Cargo.toml -p roadstyle-wasm && wasm-bindgen --target web --out-dir pkg ../target/wasm32-unknown-unknown/dist/roadstyle_wasm.wasm
scripts.prepack: test -f pkg/roadstyle_wasm_bg.wasm || (echo 'roadstyle-wasm: run npm run build first (pkg/ is missing)' >&2; exit 1)
